origin: William Playfair is known to have first drawn one in his 1786 book The Commercial and Political Atlas, showing changes in imports and exports.
whenToUse: You look at trends over time.
You compare two or three series on the same axis, such as this year and last year.
There are so many points that bars would be crowded.
whenNotToUse: Comparing unordered items (use a bar chart).
Two values with different units in one chart (split the chart).
A small trend inside a card (use a sparkline).

alternatives.name: Sparkline
alternatives.reason: Showing just a small trend without axes.

accessibility: With focus on the chart area, moving the point with ←/→ reads the values via aria-live.
Series are told apart by the legend and names at the line ends, not color alone.
Opening the table view shows every value as a table.
